top_signals.title: Commission partially greenlights Malta's final payment request for €61.7 million under NextGenerationEU
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 20 Nov 2026 Today, the European Commission partially greenlighted Malta's fifth and final payment request for €61.7 million under the Recovery and Resilience Facility (RRF), the centrepiece of NextGenerationEU.

top_signals.title: Commission greenlights Portugal's final payment request for €4.7 billion under NextGenerationEU

top_signals.title: From ukiyo-e to ‘Godzilla,’ where do Japanese monsters stand in the Asian imagination?
